_provenance: logs/*/games/*.json and logs/*/turns.jsonl, frozen at 2026-08-19T23:26:26; 696 completed persuasion games
question: how much of the persuasion decline does the message-classifier bug explain?
answer: none of it, and the decline is not a decline

timing.interleaving: none: every pre-fix game precedes every post-fix game
timing.consequence: the buggy classifier was live during the HIGH-scoring opening window (53.3% at n=27) and was removed before the flat window. A bug present only in the good period cannot cause a later decline.

bug_definition.what: the pre-fix reads_as_recommendation was a flat blacklist of eight phrases
bug_definition.scope: TEXT message mode only; binary yes/no messages are parsed identically by both versions
bug_definition.measured_error: on the 67 distinct field-seller text messages in pre-fix logs the two classifiers disagree on 12, covering 133 of 540 pre-fix text buyer rounds (24.6%). Every disagreement is the same error: an honest warning read as a recommendation.
examples: This unit is below our usual quality this round. (40 rounds)
Ordinary unit this round. Still available at the same price. (15)
Not this round. Wait for a better unit. (7)
bug_definition.recovery_method: the pre-fix buyer plans log the classifier's verdict per message, so the old verdicts are read directly out of logs/*.pre-fix/turns.jsonl rather than reconstructed

buyer_side.direction: the old classifier counted honest warnings as recommendations, so low-quality rounds bought after a warning were charged to the recommendation bucket, depressing p_high

seller_side.direction: an inflated lie counter made the pre-fix seller MORE honest than intended, and only inside the 17% lie-budget branch

causal_estimate.design: difference in differences. The bug can only bite in TEXT mode, so BINARY games are the control group across the same fix.
causal_estimate.interpretation: the bug's estimated effect on percentile is -6.1 points with a 95% interval from -20 to +8; it is statistically indistinguishable from zero and its sign says text got WORSE after the fix, not better
causal_estimate.power: to resolve a 5-percentile-point DiD at 80% power needs about 2,100 games per cell (8,400 total). We have 47 in the smallest cell.

is_there_a_decline.metric: config-matched field-proxy percentile, kernel-smoothed, 430 games with >=5 field comparisons
is_there_a_decline.verdict: no monotone trend; the last quartile is the highest. The reported 53.3 -> 46.0 -> 44.9 series is a cumulative mean regressing from a lucky opening window of 27 games, exactly as an earlier analysis concluded.
is_there_a_decline.mde: a single game's proxy percentile has sd about 0.29, so detecting a genuine 8-point shift needs about 205 games per arm and a 4-point shift about 819

what_is_actually_wrong.not: a regression over time, a classifier bug, or a broken seat
is: the buyer never uses the free information in the seller's message frequency: it sets p_high = p until a purchase has been paid for (see persuasion_buyer_belief_v1)
the seller's honesty knobs are bypassed in 66% of seller games by the 'prior alone justifies purchase' and 'no valuations' branches (see persuasion_seller_policy_v1)
on the config-matched proxy both seats sit at the 50th percentile: there is no single broken component, and reaching the top ten requires beating the field rather than matching it

confounds_checked.probe_mix: stable at ~25% each through quartiles 1-3; quartile 4 shifts to 53% champion / 38% hardliner. Irrelevant to the pre/post comparison, which lives entirely inside quartile 1.
